title: Natural Hom comparison on an ordinary étale factored chart
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $f:X\to Y$, $s:U\hookrightarrow X$, $v:V\hookrightarrow Y$, $i:U\hookrightarrow P$ and $p:P\to V$ be morphisms between Noetherian schemes, with $s,v$ open, $i$ closed and $fs=vpi$. Suppose all the displayed morphisms and their composites are separated of finite type and admit compactifications. Work in the ordinary unbounded étale module-sheaf derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with compact supports of [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and right adjoints $f^\times,p^\times,i^\times$ of [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. For every $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ set $B=i^\times p^\times v^*K$. For every bounded-below $H\in D(U_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ there are bijections, natural in $H$ and $K$, $$\operatorname{Hom}(H,B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(H,s^*f^\times K).$$ They are the inverse of the chain $$\operatorname{Hom}(H,s^*f^\times K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(s_!H,f^\times K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(Rf_!s_!H,K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(v_!Rp_!i_*H,K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(Rp_!i_*H,v^*K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(H,B),$$ using the ordinary adjunction bijections and compact-support composition on bounded-below inputs. Neither $B$ nor $s^*f^\times K$ is assumed bounded below.
